class.name: IfcCompositeCurveOnSurface
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 A composite curve on surface is a collection of segments which are curves on a surface. Each segment shall lie on the basis surface. There shall be at least positional continuity between adjacent segments. The parameterization of the composite curve is obtained from the accumulation of the parametric ranges of the segments.
